final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS z, s.entrystat AS e, AVG(f.traitcount) AS a, COUNT(*) AS c FROM scanfeatures f JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = f.zoneref WHERE f.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1) SELECT s1.z, s1.e, s1.a, s1.c, CASE WHEN s2.t = 0 THEN NULL ELSE s1.c * 1.0 / s2.t END AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
